title: Existing RGB dataset FDI annotation feasibility audit
scope: READ-ONLY inspection of datasets already on disk. No labeling, training, merging, or modification of images/annotations/models/app.

clinical_separation.zenodo_d_D: primary vs permanent decay DETECTION only; not ICDAS; not FDI

most_important_finding: FDI NOT CURRENTLY AVAILABLE. Existing boxes are lesion boxes, not whole-tooth boxes. Existing ICDAS scores are not FDI.

questions.q2_realistic_manual_fdi_on_existing_rgb: NO as conversion of existing boxes; POSSIBLY only after new whole-tooth boxes plus dentist FDI on a subset

q3_teeth_needing_manual_fdi.if_labeling_existing_lesion_boxes: NOT APPLICABLE — those boxes are lesions, not teeth

estimate_if_boxing_all_6265_zenodo_views.method: view counts times assumed visible teeth: retractor occlusal 1100*14; no-retractor occlusal 1102*12; pilot occlusal 303*13; frontal 1259*12; laterals 2501*8

estimate_if_only_retractor_occlusal.method: 551 maxillary occlusal + 549 mandibular under retractors, assume 14 visible teeth per image

questions.q4_practical_for_major_project: NO as the primary path to 32-class FDI

recommended_strategy.name: Existing data is insufficient for FDI; continue legitimate FDTooth / PhysioNet credentialing
recommended_strategy.why: Local RGB has no whole-tooth localization and no FDI. Converting Zenodo d/D boxes into FDI would be scientifically invalid. Boxing and FDI-labeling ~6,265 full-mouth photos is not a reasonable student-project workload. Stage 2D already identified FDTooth as the only verified RGB + whole-tooth + FDI source (restricted, anterior-only).

not_chosen.A: There are no existing whole-tooth boxes to attach FDI to.
not_chosen.B: Partial FDI on lesion boxes is still the wrong object. Additional acquisition would still be required after first drawing tooth boxes.
not_chosen.C: New collection is likely needed later for 32-class coverage, but is not the highest-value immediate next step given a documented restricted FDI RGB set.
not_chosen.E: Long-term combination (FDTooth + later posterior RGB + Zenodo lesion-only) is plausible, but the single next action is credentialed FDTooth access, not merging datasets now.

feasibility.tooth_detection_if_new_whole_tooth_boxes: POSSIBLY — 6,265 RGB intraoral frames exist, but that is new annotation work, not reuse of current boxes
feasibility.fdi_after_manual_labeling: POSSIBLY for anterior/occlusal subsets with a dentist; NO as a balanced 32-class dataset from this repo alone without large new annotation

datasets_inventoried.name: Annotated intraoral image dataset for dental caries detection
datasets_inventoried.research_use: CC BY 4.0 typically permits research use with attribution; this is not legal advice
datasets_inventoried.manual_derivative_annotations: Attribution-required derivatives are commonly allowed under CC BY 4.0; not a legal determination

images.view_type: full-mouth / arch / lateral segments, not single-tooth crops
images.quality: Generally high; flash highlights; variable resolution; laterals often shallow DOF

annotations.note: Do not count lesion annotations as tooth annotations. COCO test.json category ids are inverted vs train/valid (Stage 2C).

test.note: category ids inverted: id 1 = D, id 2 = d

patient_like_ids.patient_level_split_possible: POSSIBLY for the 889 parsed IDs; not verified as true patient IDs; 1909 images lack this pattern

datasets_inventoried.name: dataset/annotations.csv (ICDAS crop index without pixels)
datasets_inventoried.license_documented: NOT VERIFIED for the missing image files
datasets_inventoried.note: Filenames look like tooth crops from mandibular/maxillary/lateral views. ICDAS 0-4 is caries severity, not tooth identity. Files are missing; cannot annotate FDI on absent pixels.

excluded_5.type: RGB photos, often tight tooth/lesion crops; some appear to be photos of a screen

11.evidence: No FDI field in any local annotation. Occlusal/frontal photos may show maxillary anteriors; identity not proven.

fdi_classes_possibly_present_without_ide: Visual arch photos exist; do not treat position as verified FDI

images_easy_estimate.definition: retractors Maxillary_Occlusal (551) + retractors Mandibular (549); sampled occlusal shows full single-jaw arch

images_medium_estimate.definition: pilot Maxillary_Occlusal (152) + pilot Mandibular (151); same views as easy set but smaller/pilot protocol

images_ambiguous_estimate.definition: all laterals 2501 + all frontals 1259 + no_retractors occlusal 1102 (551 mandibular + 551 maxillary); overlap, missing landmarks, or two jaws. 1100+303+4862=6265.

images_probably_exclude_from_standalone_.note: Laterals can still help if linked by the same anonymous ID to occlusal/frontal; they are poor as the only view

manual_effort.workload: High. Existing boxes cannot be relabeled as FDI. New whole-tooth boxes plus FDI on 6,265 images is not practical. Even the 1,100 easier occlusal frames imply ESTIMATE ~15,400 tooth labels.

position_analysis.frontal: Anterior sequence often readable; posterior out of focus; crowding/missing teeth add ambiguity; left/right is viewer-relative and must not be guessed as FDI without a dentist and mirroring policy
position_analysis.occlusal: Best single-jaw ordering; third molars may be absent; tight contacts overlap boxes
position_analysis.lateral: Quadrant-ish; overlapping crowns; exact FDI unstable without paired arch view
position_analysis.mirroring: NOT VERIFIED; no metadata stating whether images are mirrored
position_analysis.complete_arch: Common on retractor occlusal samples; not guaranteed
position_analysis.existing_lesion_box_order: Lesion boxes do not enumerate teeth and must not be used as tooth order

summary_table.Segmentation: none for teeth; COCO segmentation empty
summary_table.Teeth requiring manual FDI: 0 existing; ESTIMATE ~67679 if boxing all views
summary_table.FDI feasibility: NO with current labels; POSSIBLY only after large new annotation
summary_table.Manual annotation burden: High / not practical as primary path
